// BOM and CRLF
#include <string>
namespace u {
// café €
struct Café { int été; };
class Widget {
public:
  Widget(const std::string& n) : name_(n) {}
  std::string label() const { return "€" + name_; }
  Point where() const;
private:
  std::string name_;
};
Point Widget::where() const { Point p; return p; }
}
